root_64k_five_nvfp4_draft_heads.status: PROJECTION, NOT PINNED. Needs an FP4 draft-head GEMV unit; it is a byte lever with its own gate, and no instrument may quote it as a floor until that lands.

retired_scenarios.draft_head_fp8: FR13_DRAFT_HEAD_FP8 is DEAD under both FR14 arms. It re-read the five K64 draft heads as FP8 qweight + FP32 scales (1_678_131_200 B instead of 3_355_443_200 B). Arm A serves a BF16 head (unsloth's FP8 per-channel head was dequantised to make the checkpoint loadable); arm B serves an NVFP4 head whose sliced rows PHASE 1 dequantises to BF16 at boot. Neither leaves an FP8 head to read, so the arm would pin a floor the hardware cannot realise. The launcher and the floor-timer sequence refuse it. The live successor is the NVFP4 draft-head read below, which is a real 8.834 ms and needs an FP4 GEMV unit, not a requant.
